example.title: Garibaldi fishing pier with its pier-end shed

brief: A long narrow timber fishing pier on bents of round creosoted piles, a plank deck with a timber rail and a small gabled red shed at the end over the bay. One photo. Older than 1970: wooden bay fishing piers of this kind date from the 1920s-30s. Piles carried 10 m or more below the modelled bed (spec rule 4).
